day_local: Iidda Quduus Matayos, Rasuul iyo Injiil-qore
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha iyo Wiilka iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Dhawaaqoodu wuxuu gaadhaa dhulka oo dhan.
homily:
Waxaa jira sawir yar oo maanta maskaxdayda ku soo dhacaya, sawir ka duwan kii shalay. Waxaan arkaa qol yar oo ay ku jiraan miis iyo kursi, halkaas oo uu fadhiyo nin magaciisa la yidhaahdo Matayos. Wuxuu gacanta ku hayaa qalin iyo warqado xisaab ah, isagoo si taxaddar leh u ururinaya canshuurta. Wuxuu ahaa nin dunida u arkayay xisaab iyo tirooyin. Laakiin markaas, waxaa soo maray Ciise. Ciise ma eegin miiska, mana eegin lacagta. Wuxuu eegay indhaha Matayos. Wuxuu ku yidhi hal kelmad oo beddeshay aayaha ninkaas: 'I soo raac.' Matayos ma uusan weydiin, 'Xaggee?' ama 'Maxaa dhacaya?' Wuu kacay, wuu ka tagay miiskiisii, wuxuuna bilaabay safar aan dhammaad lahayn.

Waxaan ka fikirayaa Benjamin-keenna qaali ah. Waxaan xusuustaa sida uu u jeclaa inuu wax walba u xisaabiyo, sida uu ugu raaxaysan jiray koodhka kumbuyuutarka iyo qaab-dhismeedka diyaaradaha. Ben wuxuu lahaa maskax aad u fiiqan, laakiin wuxuu lahaa qalbi ka sii weyn. Mararka qaarkood, markaan eegno nolosha qof yar oo naga tagay, waxaan is-weydiinnaa: 'Sidee ayay tani u noqon kartaa qorshaha Ilaah?' Waxaan u baahannahay inaan xusuusanno in nolosha Ben aysan ahayn wax la tiriyo, balse ay tahay wax la wadaago. Sida Matayos oo kale, Ben wuxuu ahaa qof uu Ciise u yeedhay, qof uu Ciise dhex fadhiistay, qof uu Ciise u soo bandhigay naxariis aan xad lahayn.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in Ciise uu la fadhiistay canshuur-qaadayaal iyo dembiilayaal. Farisiisku way yaabeen. Waxay yidhaahdeen, 'Maxuu macallinkiinnu ula cunaa dadkan?' Ciise wuxuu u jawaabay: 'Kuwa caafimaadka qaba uma baahna dhakhtar, kuwa bukaase way u baahan yihiin.' Erayadan waa kuwo aan maanta u baahannahay inaan si qoto dheer u dhuuxno. Waxaan ogahay in qalbiyadiinna, Alan iyo Thao, ay maanta u baahan yihiin dhakhtarkaas. Waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay dareemayeen sida buur culus oo saaran xabadka. Waxaan rabaa inaan si cad idiin sheego: Jacaylka aad u hayseen Ben, habeenadii aad la soo jeeddeen, codkiisii aad u maqasheen, dhammaantood waxay ahaayeen naxariis Ilaah oo idin dhex maraysay.

Waxaa laga yaabaa in qaar idinka mid ah ay dareemaan inaysan wax badan qaban karin. Waxaa laga yaabaa inaad is-weydiinaysaan haddii aad wax seegteen. Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta kuu sheego, walaalkay Alan, iyo adiga Thao, in aadan waxba seegin. Ilaah ma aha mid xisaabiyaha gacanta ku haysta oo sugaya inaad qalad gashaan. Ilaah waa Aabbe. Markii Ciise la weydiiyay sababta ninku uu u dhashay indhoolaha, wuxuu yidhi: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Dhibaatada iyo xanuunka adduunkan ma aha ciqaab. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil qurux badan, oo hadda ku jira gacmaha Aabbihiis oo Jannada jooga. Ha is-eedeynin. Ha is-weydiin waxa dhici lahaa haddii aad sidan ama si kale samayn lahaydeen. Waxaad siisay jacayl aan xad lahayn, waana taas waxa uu Ben xambaarsan yahay.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in dunidaadu ay isbeddeshay. Waxaan ogahay in kursiga agtaada ah uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid madhan. Laakiin xusuuso, Ben wuxuu kula joogaa jacaylka aad u hayso. Sida uu kuugu sheegay riyadaada, halkaas oo aad ku wada raacdeen 'roller coaster', xidhiidhka idinka dhexeeya wuu sii socdaa. Ha ka cabsan inaad noolaato, ha ka cabsan inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdo. 

Waxaan rabaa inaan wax yar ka sheego 'Con Chim Airlines'. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil riyoon jiray. Wuxuu rabay inuu wax dhiso, inuu wax abuuro. Inkastoo diyaaraddaas aysan ka duulin garoonka, haddana jacaylka uu Ben u hayay dadka kale, sida rabitaankiisii ahaa inuu caawiyo adeerkiis William, waa diyaarad weligeed duulaysa. Waa jacayl ka gudbaya xuduudaha dhimashada. Waa jacayl maanta ku nool qalbiyada dadka uu taabtay.

Maanta, markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan, waxaan rabaa inaad qaadataan hal shay oo yar: Ha isku dayin inaad xalliso xanuunkaaga adigoo isticmaalaya xisaabtaada. Ha isku dayin inaad fahanto sababta uu Ben u baxay. Kaliya u dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise, sida Matayos uu u dhiibay miiskiisii. U oggolow inuu kula fadhiisto, kula cuno, oo kula qaybsado xanuunkaaga. Ciise ma aha mid iska fogeeya kuwa murugaysan; wuxuu u yimid inuu la fadhiisto. Wuxuu rabaa inuu noqdo dhakhtarkaaga maanta. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu dhiibaynaa nafta Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay, inuu Rabbigu u furo albaabada Jannada oo uu ku siiyo nabad weligeed ah.
Rabbiyow, waxaan kuu dhiibaynaa qoyska Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwa murugaysan, inuu Ruuxa Quduuska ah u soo dejiyo raaxo, xoog, iyo rajo aan dhammaanayn.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Sidaas darteed anigoo maxbuus Rabbiga aawadiis ah, waxaan idinku boorrinayaa inaad u socotaan si u qalanta yeedhistii laydinku yeedhay, idinkoo leh is-hoosaysiin iyo qabow, iyo dulqaadasho, idinkoo isku dulqaadanaya jacayl, idinkoo ku dadaalaya inaad ilaalisaan midnimada Ruuxa xagga xidhitaanka nabadda. Waxaa jira hal jidh iyo hal Ruux, sidii laydinku yeedhay hal rajo oo yeedhistaada ah; hal Rabbiga ah, hal iimaan ah, hal baabtiis ah; hal Ilaah iyo Aabbaha dadka oo dhan, kan ka sarreeya wax walba, oo wax walba dhex mara, oo wax walba ku jira. Laakiin midkeen kasta waxaa la siiyey nimco sidii cabbirka hadiyadda Masiixu ahayd. Isaguna wuxuu qaar ka dhigay rasuullo, qaar nebiyo, qaar injiil-qorayaal, qaar daajiyayaal iyo macallimiin, si uu quduusiinta ugu diyaariyo shaqada adeegga, si loo dhiso jidhka Masiixa, ilaa aynu dhammaanteen gaadhno midnimada iimaanka iyo aqoonta Wiilka Ilaah, in aynu noqonno nin qaangaadh ah, ilaa aynu gaadhno cabbirka buuxa ee Masiixa.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Samooyinku waxay sheegaan ammaanta Ilaah; oo hawaduna waxay muujisaa shuqulkii gacmihiisa. Maalintu maalinta kale ayay hadal u gudbisaa, oo habeenkuna habeenka kale ayuu aqoon u muujiyaa. Ma jiro hadal ama hadal aan codkooda la maqlayn. Dhulka oo dhan ayuu codkoodu gaadhaa, oo dunida darafyadeedana waxaa gaadha hadalkooda.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise markuu halkaas ka gudbayay, wuxuu arkay nin la odhan jiray Matayos oo fadhiya xafiiska canshuuraha, wuxuuna ku yidhi, 'I soo raac.' Markaasuu kacay oo raacay. Markuu guriga dhexdiisa miiska la fadhiyay, waxaa yimid canshuur-qaadayaal iyo dembiilayaal badan oo la fadhiistay Ciise iyo xertiisa. Farisiintii markay arkeen, waxay xertiisa ku yidhaahdeen, 'Maxuu macallinkiinnu ula cunaa canshuur-qaadayaasha iyo dembiilayaasha?' Markuu maqlay, wuxuu ku yidhi, 'Kuwa caafimaadka qaba uma baahna dhakhtar, kuwa bukaase way u baahan yihiin. Haddaba taga oo barta waxa ay tahay, 'Waxaan rabaa naxariis, ee ma rabo allabari.' Waayo, uma aan iman inaan u yeedho kuwa xaqa ah, laakiin waxaan u imid inaan u yeedho kuwa dembiilayaasha ah.'

spiritual_communion: Ciiseey, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax walba, waxaanan rabaa inaan naftayda ku siiyo. Maadaama aanan hadda kuu qaadan karin Sakramental ahaan, fadlan naftayda ku soo gal si ruuxi ah. Waxaan ku soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey ii dhex jooga, waxaanan naftayda si buuxda kuugu dhiibayaa. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin dhawro, wejigiisana ha idiin iftiimiyo. Nabadda Masiixa ha idinla jirto had iyo goorba.

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
